blocks.text: Setting up single sign-on (SSO) account authentication requires generating a SAML Entity ID and Reply URL in the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform).
If you don't have access to this feature, contact your Zscaler Account team or Zscaler Support for assistance.

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click the Profile menu in the top navigation bar, and click Account Settings.
In the Authenticate section:
Email Domain: Your organization's email domain, from the General Settings section.
Authentication Type: Select SAML from the drop-down menu.
If the Authentication Type drop-down menu is disabled, enter your organization's email domain name in the General Settings section and save your changes to enable it.
Identity Provider Name: Select the identity provider your organization uses (e.g., Okta).
SAML XML Metadata: Enter the configuration metadata generated by your SSO provider:
Click Generate SAML Details to generate values for Entity ID and Reply URL.
See image.
Copy the Entity ID and Reply URL values and use them to create the XML metadata, following the setup steps for your SSO provider:
Configuring Microsoft Entra ID SSO
Configuring Okta SSO
Configuring PingOne SSO
Configuring PingFederate SSO
Configuring SecureAuth SSO
Paste the generated XML metadata from your SSO provider into the SAML XML Metadata field.
Disable welcome emails: Select the checkbox to disable the onboarding messages sent to new SSO users.
Idle Time For Logout: Select the default period of inactivity after which SSO users are logged out (e.g., Never, 1 hour, 2 hours).
See image.
Click Save.
